title: Make the widget showcase use the current version of is.js
body:
Right now, we use the current stable version to generate the [widget showcase](https://community.algolia.com/instantsearch.js/v2/widgets.html) on our documentation website. However, for consistency and dev purposes we should use the built version of instantsearch.js (which is generated by docgen).

**Bug: What is the current behavior?**

If we try to use, the built version it fails with preact errors and no widget are displayed.

**Bug: What is the expected behavior?**

No errors and we can see all the widgets.

**Bug: What browsers are impacted? Which versions?**

All

**Bug: What is the proposed solution?**

Use the footer\_script block to load the scripts after instantsearch.js and make the built version work.
